title: Add notion-home-plugin to community plugins
head: suxin17:add-notion-home-plugin
body:
Adding my Notion-style Home & Tasks plugin to the community plugins list.

## Plugin
- **Name**: Notion-style Home & Tasks
- **ID**: notion-home-plugin
- **Repo**: https://github.com/suxin17/notion-home-plugin
- **Author**: suxin17
- **Latest release**: v0.8.0

## Description
Notion-style Home page (banner + avatar + two columns) with task manager (Table/Board/Gantt views), built-in timer, work-time heatmap, pie chart, sub-task editor, **Pomodoro focus mode, daily streak, habit tracker**, and bilingual UI.

## What's new in v0.8.0
- Pomodoro / focus mode attached to each task row (4 visual states)
- Daily streak with configurable threshold (default 60s)
- Habit tracker (binary + count mode, 7-day week strip)
- Pomodoro config UI + module toggles
- Today's pomodoro count on Home streak card

## Submission checklist
- [x] Plugin follows Obsidian developer policies
- [x] Plugin has minimal API version (v1.4.0)
- [x] Plugin has a valid manifest.json
- [x] Plugin has a LICENSE (MIT)
- [x] Plugin has a README (Chinese + English)
- [x] Plugin has at least one GitHub release (v0.8.0)
- [x] Tested on Windows 11 + Obsidian v1.4+

Thanks for the review!
